name: 2010 World Championships Deck: LuxChomp of the Spirit

releases.name: 2010 World Championships Deck: LuxChomp of the Spirit

description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2010 World Championships. LuxChomp decks, built on Luxray GL LV.X and Garchomp C LV.X, were the ones to beat that year and won the Senior Division too. Luxray GL LV.X's Bright Look switches the opponent's Pokémon, Garchomp C LV.X's Dragon Rush does 80 damage to any of them, and Poké Turn returns key Pokémon to the hand to play again. The 2010 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa Village, Hawaii, from 13 to 15 August 2010.

Pokémon sold it as a 2010 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
